metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully changed Chrome profile name from 'Person 1' to 'Thomas' using the Customise profile settings page.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open Chrome profile menu, navigate settings, enter text in text fields, and navigate to web pages.
metadata.explanation: Chains the profile rename (Thomas) with bookmarking Wikipedia's homepage (wikipedia.org) to the bookmarks bar. Custom getter reads profile.name from Preferences and collects bookmark URLs from the 'bookmark_bar' root only in the Bookmarks file (not 'other' or 'synced' roots). Partial credit: 0.5 for profile name, 0.5 for a bookmark_bar URL containing 'wikipedia.org'. Initial state has no Wikipedia bookmark, so initial state does not pass. [Fixed: renamed functions from truncated 8-char suffix '32f62523' to correct 32-char MD5 hash 'f302c5cc6d17b170f6df5e52c54310d0'; replaced nested named helper '_collect_urls' with inline iterative stack-based traversal to avoid getter naming rule violation; restricted bookmark traversal to 'bookmark_bar' root only to prevent false positives from 'Other bookmarks' or 'Mobile bookmarks'; renamed return key from 'bookmark_urls' to 'bookmark_bar_urls' for semantic clarity]
fix_history: Fix 1: Renamed getter 'get_chrome_profile_bookmark__32f62523' to 'get_chrome_profile_bookmark__f302c5cc6d17b170f6df5e52c54310d0' (correct MD5 of '2ae9ba84-3a0d-4d4c-8338-3a1478dc5fe3|4')
Fix 3: Updated evaluator.func and evaluator.result.type in JSON to use new 32-char hash
Fix 4: Renamed nested helper function 'collect_urls' to '_collect_urls' to avoid getter naming rule violation
Fix 5: Replaced nested named function '_collect_urls' with inline iterative stack-based URL traversal; validator requires all functions in getter files to start with 'get_'

Fix 6: Restricted bookmark traversal from 'list(roots.values())' to '[roots.get("bookmark_bar", {})]' so only bookmarks bar entries are checked, preventing false positives from 'Other bookmarks' or 'Mobile bookmarks'
Fix 7: Renamed return key 'bookmark_urls' to 'bookmark_bar_urls' in getter and updated metric to match, making semantic intent explicit

Bookmark check is correct: getter traverses ONLY the 'bookmark_bar' root (stack = [roots.get('bookmark_bar', {})]), matching the instruction requirement to bookmark 'to the bookmarks bar' specifically.
URL substring check for 'wikipedia.org' correctly matches any Wikipedia homepage URL (e.g., https://www.wikipedia.org/, https://en.wikipedia.org/) (0.5 partial credit).
Negative control resistance confirmed: initial state has profile name 'Person 1' (not 'Thomas') and no Wikipedia bookmark in bookmark bar, so initial state scores 0.0.
